\n **研究目标** \n 根据分子结构预测水溶解度，并比较模型:
**Objective**
Predict aqueous solubility from molecular structure and evaluate performance beyond the training data.

**Models**
Random Forest (RF) uses seven molecular descriptors; the graph neural network (GNN) uses atoms and bonds. Both point models use the same fixed 920 ESOL training records.

**Intervals**
Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) uses a separate quantile model and calibration set. Nominal coverage is 90%; consult observed coverage. This is not a per-molecule probability guarantee.

**Scope**
Temperature, pH and complete miscibility are not explicitly modelled. Similarity and descriptor checks inform applicability. Predictions do not replace measurements.
此前研究流程记录的结果；GNN 为当前网页使用的随机种子 42。: Saved evaluation results; GNN denotes the deployed seed-42 model.
\n **指标含义** \n MAE（Mean Absolute:
**Metrics**
Mean Absolute Error (MAE) measures average absolute deviation. Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) gives larger errors greater weight. Lower values are better; both are in logS units.

**Findings**
Seed-42 GNN outperforms RF on the ESOL holdout, but has higher external MAE and RMSE on AqSolDB. Holdout performance alone does not establish superiority on new data.

**Evaluation boundary**
Both point models use the same fixed training set. External records undergo structure and overlap screening, which does not establish independence of original experimental sources. Three GNN seeds were evaluated; this table reports seed 42.
\n **训练与留出评价数据** \n 使用 Delaney 水溶:
**ESOL**
Delaney's Estimated SOLubility dataset provides experimental aqueous-solubility labels. After cleaning, 1,106 records were split by structural groups into 920 training and 186 holdout records.

**AqSolDB**
The Aqueous Solubility Database provides external evaluation. Structure validity, components, charge, overlap and duplicate screening leave 6,578 primary records.

**PubChem annotation pilot**
Of 100 randomly sampled molecules, 98 had exact structure matches; 26 had solubility sections, yielding 81 annotations. Manual review retained 14 converted aqueous-solubility records for 10 molecules.

**Interpretation**
Original text, sources, citations, temperature and units are retained. Annotations may share underlying experiments or differ in conditions or chemical form. This is a provenance and numerical audit, not a new independent validation set. AqSolDB labels were not modified using these records.
